messages:
Taylor - CS Ops: Quick handshake heatcheck — EBR dry run tomorrow 3pm. Can we lock slide owners and the 3 priority asks per exec? I'll run the readout.
Alex M: +1. I can take the 'Onboarding & Adoption' slides. Will surface top 2 onboarding blockers per account.
Priya S: I'll own 'Renewal Risks' and bring the latest risk matrix. Need updated burn + adoption by EOD. @Alex M can you add adoption delta for AtlasPay?
Alex M: Yep, will pull AtlasPay delta and add a one-liner.
Jordan: I'll cover 'Platform Health / Incidents'. Short bullets only — want to avoid deep ops details in the exec deck.
Sam (CS): For enablement, I suggest a 1-slide plan: enablement playbook + key onboarding wins. Also have customer feedback highlights (2 quotes) to include. Who's capturing those?
Priya S: I can grab the feedback quotes from last week's NPS notes. @Sam (CS) pls confirm which accounts to highlight (focus on renewals).
Sam (CS): Highlight Meridian and Crestline. I'll DM raw quotes and the preference of the exec sponsor.
Emily (CRO): Heads up — exec wants the ask phrased as: 1) resource for a targeted success pod, 2) a committed technical enablement hour/week, 3) decision on pricing concession. Keep it short.
Taylor - CS Ops: Noted. I'll add an 'Explicit Asks' slide with those three lines and A/B CTA.
DeployBot: Reminder: Slide deck versioning enforced. Uploaded: https://redwood.slides/ebrs/1767779999/v1 (auto).
Priya S: Action items list so far: Priya - risk matrix & quotes; Alex - onboarding deltas; Jordan - platform bullets; Sam - enablement slide + account quotes; Taylor - assemble deck + run the dry run.
Alex M: ETA: onboarding deltas in the doc by 5pm.
Jordan: Platform bullets in by 6pm PST.
Sam (CS): I'll post the quotes thread here in 30m.
Taylor - CS Ops: Two small asks before dry run: 1) add owner initials on each slide footer, 2) mark any sensitive PII rows in the spreadsheet with REDACT.
Priya S: Will redact PII and add initials.
Emily (CRO): Can we also include a single-slide ROI snapshot for the top 3 at-risk accounts? Keep numbers high-level.
Alex M: I have a quick ROI calc for AtlasPay and Brightlane — will add top line.
Taylor - CS Ops: Great. Dry run agenda: 3:00–3:05 intro, 3:05–3:25 slides, 3:25–3:40 exec Q&A prep (we'll roleplay), 3:40–3:45 finalize asks. Please be on time.
Priya S: Added a short 'Mitigation Plan' checklist to the risks slide — 3 bullet actions per account.
Sam (CS): Posted quotes: "Redwood cut our latency in half" (Meridian) and "Support was great during onboarding" (Crestline).
Taylor - CS Ops: Awesome. Last thing: capture feedback during the dry run in the shared doc under /feedback/dryrun-notes so we can action immediately.
Alex M: Will take notes.
Jordan: I'll record the session and drop link.
Taylor - CS Ops: Thanks team. See you at 3pm tomorrow. :thumbsup:
